findings.reason: the write path must also name `reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py` (to surface the rendered state, questions and template digest on the selection) and `reckon/crew/dispatch.py` (to pass them at the hold site); without them the node cannot run on the real code path and the reproducibility §32 promises is unachievable.
findings.text: §32 directs recording "the exact state and questions sent to Jev" but names only "the module that writes picker-holds.jsonl under reckon/crew/picker/" (reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py) and a new test module as write paths; the rendered state and the questions are built and consumed inside `pick()` (reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:319 `state.jinja`, :371 `questions.jinja`) and never leave it — the returned `Selection` carries only `rendered_token_estimate` (reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:431), and the sole production caller `record_picker_hold` (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:685) holds only that Selection, so a worker fenced to outcomes.py cannot obtain the bytes without re-rendering them, which is precisely what §32 exists to prevent

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `docs/state/reckon/picker-holds.jsonl` resolves in the main checkout (untracked there, as §28 already records), and "the module that writes picker-holds.jsonl under reckon/crew/picker/" resolves to `reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py:118`.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §32's done-when is a digest-equality measurement and declares a negative control ("It fails on main, where the row carries no state"), and `record_picker_hold` on main (reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py:135) writes exactly the six fields §32 lists and no state, so the control can fail.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §32 claims no session-scratch or node-local path; its only durable artifact is the holds file under `docs/state/<project>/` plus a manifest metric.
rubric_items.naming: pass — neither the §32 heading nor its prose carries a ticket number, version tag or stage name into a symbol or comment.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §32's write path cannot reach the state it must record.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §32 names one deliverable, extending the hold record so a replay is exact.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §32 declares no `depends-on`; the sections it names (§15, §28) are `done`, and this plan's settled precedent is that an edge to a done section is not added, so no edge is missing.
